integrity.computational_support: finite integer optimization and middle-level family enumeration
integrity.proof_basis: explicit support adjacency, complementary pairs, strict singleton exclusion and equality rigidity
integrity.unproved_scope: arbitrary unequal field orders; external independent validation

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to products of at least five identical finite fields of order at least three; it does not determine the clique number of unequal-field products. Finite optimization tests provide checks, not a proof. An unindexed pre-existing equivalent treatment of coatom-truncated weighted intersecting families remains possible.
title: Exact clique number and maximizers for weak difference graphs of homogeneous finite-field products
